annotations.title: Search phone numbers to buy (by country)

description: List phone numbers available to purchase for a country (via Twilio), so you can pick one to buy as the account's SIM/number. Pass the chosen phoneNumber to gambot_create_trial_account / gambot_create_paid_account as simInfo.selectedSimNumber with simInfo.purchaseInTwilio=true.
name: gambot_search_available_numbers
title: Search phone numbers to buy (by country)
